image_slots.section_excerpt: The core of minimalism is the capsule wardrobe. By selecting versatile, neutral-colored clothing, travelers can mix and match outfits for any occasion without carrying excess weight.

When you travel with less, you have the physical and mental energy to explore further. Walking through ancient forests or hiking coastal trails becomes the focus of the trip, rather than managing lugg
Embracing this mindset transforms the journey. The world opens up when you carry only what you need.
